correctness.rationale: The first two falling factorial moment curves determine the plant-degree and pair-union histograms, but not triple unions. For three or fewer plants the probability of zero served (q^m) with first two moments determines the entire law; for one/two pollinators the two single-survivor degrees plus endpoints determine it. Independent exhaustive canonical connected-graph enumeration gives no different-law moment twins for four plants and three pollinators, and exactly four classes at (4,4) plus one at (5,3). The explicit 4+4 witness has identical EY=4-3q^2-q^4 and E(Y)_2=12-18q^2+6q^3 yet all-served probability gap q^3(1-q), maximizing at 27/256. Connectedness and guild-preserving unlabeled isomorphism were retained.

A November 8 nine-species theorem concerns reversal of variance between fixed-retention budgets with identical degrees, not indistinguishability of full mean and variance curves under Bernoulli failures. No primary result inspected yields the five-pair connected eight-species classification.
